detail: On PR #179 (no toollog change) CI's 'test' job failed once in internal/toollog TestSweepWhileWriting ('30 sweeps trimmed, writer dropped 227; want trims and no drops') and passed on re-run; it passes locally. Likely load-dependent on shared runners (the writer's queue overflows while sweeps hold the write turn). Worth a look so the command log's no-drop claim is not timing-dependent.
